name: ide-css
author: lumine-code
description: CSS, SCSS and Less language-server adapter.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `vscode-css-language-server` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

customData.title: Custom Data
customData.description: CSS custom-data files or URLs that describe additional properties, at-rules, pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements. Relative paths are resolved from the project root.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of the stylesheet server the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report syntax and lint problems in the linter.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer selectors, properties, values and paths.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show CSS documentation and browser information on hover.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Jump from variables and custom properties to their definitions.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find stylesheet variable and custom-property references.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve stylesheet symbols to navigation features.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format whole stylesheets and selected ranges.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename variables and custom properties with all references.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer quick fixes for misspelled CSS properties.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Enable validation independently for each supported stylesheet syntax.

css.title: Validate CSS
css.description: Report syntax and lint diagnostics in CSS files.

scss.title: Validate SCSS
scss.description: Report syntax and lint diagnostics in SCSS files.

less.title: Validate Less
less.description: Report syntax and lint diagnostics in Less files.

completion.title: Completion
completion.description: How stylesheet completion items are generated.

triggerPropertyValueCompletion.title: Complete Property Values
triggerPropertyValueCompletion.description: Automatically offer values after a property name and colon.

completePropertyWithSemicolon.title: Insert Semicolons
completePropertyWithSemicolon.description: Include a trailing semicolon when completing a property declaration.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Content included in stylesheet hover results.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Include prose documentation for CSS features.

lint.title: Lint
lint.description: Shared lint levels for CSS, SCSS and Less. Language defaults apply to rules not listed here.

compatibleVendorPrefixes.title: Compatible Vendor Prefixes
compatibleVendorPrefixes.description: Require all compatible vendor-prefixed properties when one prefix is used.

vendorPrefix.title: Missing Standard Property
vendorPrefix.description: Require the standard property alongside a vendor-prefixed property.

duplicateProperties.title: Duplicate Properties
duplicateProperties.description: Report duplicate property declarations in one rule.

emptyRules.title: Empty Rules
emptyRules.description: Report rules that contain no declarations.

importStatement.title: Import Statements
importStatement.description: Report import statements because they prevent resources from loading in parallel.

boxModel.title: Box Model
boxModel.description: Report width or height declarations combined with padding or borders.

universalSelector.title: Universal Selector
universalSelector.description: Report use of the universal selector.

zeroUnits.title: Units on Zero
zeroUnits.description: Report units that are unnecessary on zero values.

hexColorLength.title: Hex Color Length
hexColorLength.description: Report hexadecimal colors whose length is invalid.

argumentsInColorFunction.title: Color Function Arguments
argumentsInColorFunction.description: Report color functions with an invalid number of arguments.

unknownProperties.title: Unknown Properties
unknownProperties.description: Report property names not known to the language service.

unknownAtRules.title: Unknown At-Rules
unknownAtRules.description: Report at-rules not known to the language service.

ieHack.title: Internet Explorer Hacks
ieHack.description: Report property hacks required only by Internet Explorer 7 and older.

propertyIgnoredDueToDisplay.title: Properties Ignored by Display
propertyIgnoredDueToDisplay.description: Report properties that have no effect with the selected display mode.

float.title: Avoid Float
float.description: Report declarations that use floating layout.

idSelector.title: Avoid ID Selectors
idSelector.description: Report selectors coupled to element IDs.

validProperties.title: Additional Valid Properties
validProperties.description: Property names accepted by the unknown-properties rule.
